name: Xingyu Wang
biography: Xingyu Wang is a PhD student at the University at Buffalo studying the weird edge cases of networks, phones, and systems that are supposed to “just work.” He explores how AI can help security researchers survive dense specs and turn “wait, why did it do that?” moments into better tests. He does not fully trust AI or complex systems, but he enjoys putting them in the same room and watching what breaks first.
